verification_report.summary: Correct conditional application of the accepted lower-barrier capacity criterion. The fixed estimate MA^ext_ω(v_λ)≤b e^C f dV and L1 convergence make the required exponential self-measure error vanish. All criterion hypotheses hold with θ=ω and φ=u_0. The proof explicitly retains, rather than derives, the genuine smaller-background-envelope hypothesis; bounded u_0 supplies a constant competitor.
